Zero dependencies Fine-grained reactivity Shadow DOM & CSP ready

Reactive HTML with a tiny ego.

SpruceX blends Alpine-style declarative reactivity with HTMX-style hypermedia requests, fine-grained computed caching, and element-scoped widget directives—built to scale from simple pages to data-heavy BI dashboards.

Explore 15 Live Examples → Attribute Reference 
<script src="/dist/sprucex.min.js"></script>

<div sx-data="{ count: 3, region: 'EU' }">
  <button sx-on:click="count++">Count: <span sx-text="count"></span></button>
  <button
    sx-get="/api/metrics"
    sx-params="{ region, limit: count }"
    sx-json-into.shallow="rows">
    Fetch Raw Dataset
  </button>
</div>
SpruceX.directive("chart", (el, { evaluate, effect, cleanup }) => {
  const chart = createChart(el, SpruceX.toRaw(evaluate()));

  // Re-runs ONLY when this chart's data changes
  effect(() => chart.update(SpruceX.toRaw(evaluate())));

  // Survives partial HTML swaps; runs only when el is removed
  cleanup(() => chart.destroy());
});
import SpruceX from "sprucex/core";
import { createSortableIntegration } from "sprucex/sortable";
import { createGridStackIntegration } from "sprucex/gridstack";

SpruceX.config({ baseUrl: "/api", credentials: "include" });
SpruceX.integration("sortable", createSortableIntegration());
SpruceX.init(shadowRoot); // works in Document or ShadowRoot

01 · Overview

Getting Started

Drop a single script tag into server-rendered HTML or import tree-shakeable ESM modules. SpruceX auto-initializes on DOMContentLoaded (or explicitly via SpruceX.init(root) when using sprucex/core).

01 / DECLARATIVE

Alpine-style UI

sx-data, sx-if, sx-for, sx-model, sx-style, and memoized getters keep state right next to markup.

02 / HYPERMEDIA

HTMX-style Network

sx-get/post/put/patch/delete, sx-params, sx-swap, sx-select, optimistic updates, and visibility-aware polling.

03 / EXTENSIBLE

Built for Widgets & BI

SpruceX.directive(), markRaw(), Shadow DOM scoping, and strict-CSP mode power complex charts and dashboards.

02 · Complete API

Attributes Reference

Core State & Binding

Attribute Description
sx-data Defines a reactive component scope from an object literal, function, or named SpruceX.data() factory. Own read-only getters are automatically memoized.
sx-text Evaluates an expression and sets element textContent (no-op guarded).
sx-html Evaluates an expression and sets element innerHTML (no-op guarded so unchanged subtrees keep DOM identity).
sx-show Toggles visibility via display: none while preserving existing inline display values (e.g. flex/grid).
sx-bind:<attr> Dynamically binds attributes. Preserves aria-*="false" and syncs live DOM properties (value, checked, indeterminate).
sx-class Conditionally toggles CSS classes via object or string syntax while preserving static HTML classes.
sx-style Dynamically binds inline styles via object (supports camelCase and --css-vars) or string.
sx-cloak Removed automatically after initial render; pair with [sx-cloak] { display: none !important; } to prevent FOUC.
sx-init Runs a one-time initialization statement on the element (with access to $el, $parent, $nextTick).
sx-effect Fine-grained reactive side effect on an element; re-runs only when dependencies it reads change.
sx-model Two-way binding for inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radios, and single/multiple <select>. Modifiers: .trim, .number, .boolean, .lazy, .debounce.<ms>, .debounce-ms.
sx-ref Registers the element in $refs under the given name.
sx-toggle Toggles a boolean property in state on click.
sx-init-data Embedded <script sx-init-data type="application/json"> payload for identifier-style sx-data roots.
sx-local Persists component state to localStorage under the given key (microtask-batched).
sx-error-fallback Fallback expression rendered when a binding expression throws.

Control Flow & Performance

Attribute Description
sx-if Conditionally mounts and tears down a <template> subtree—including nested sx-data components and custom directives.
sx-for Iterates over an array on <template> (e.g. item in items or (item, i) in items). Pair with sx-key for minimal keyed reconciliation.
sx-key Stable item identity for keyed sx-for reordering and DOM morphing.
sx-memo Explicitly memoizes sx-text or sx-html based on a dependency key array.
sx-lazy Defers component initialization until the element intersects the viewport (also works inside swaps and loops).
sx-preserve Skips modifying this element during DOM morphing (keeps live inputs/media untouched).

Events & Magics

Attribute Description
sx-on:<event> Attaches an event listener (lazily delegated). Modifiers: .prevent, .stop, .self, .once, .outside, .window, .document, .passive, .capture, .debounce.<ms>, .throttle.<ms>.
Keyboard modifiers Combine system keys (.ctrl, .alt, .shift, .meta, .cmd) with key names or aliases (.enter, .esc, .space, .up, .down, .left, .right, .del). Example: sx-on:keydown.ctrl.enter.
Expression magics Available in expressions: $event, $el, $refs, $store(name), $emit(name, detail), $dispatch(name, detail), $nextTick(fn?), $parent, and $index.

Network & Hypermedia (HTMX-style)

Attribute Description
sx-get / post / put / patch / delete Declarative HTTP request method and URL template.
sx-trigger Trigger event(s) (default: click, forms use submit). Supports load, input.debounce.300, and cross-component event from:window|document|#selector.
sx-trigger-debounce Fallback debounce duration (ms) applied to all triggers on the element.
sx-target CSS selector for the DOM target where HTML responses swap (defaults to triggering element).
sx-swap Swap strategy: innerHTML, outerHTML, before, after, prepend, append, morph, delete, or none.
sx-select CSS selector extracted from an HTML response before swapping.
sx-push-url / sx-replace-url Updates browser history URL on successful requests (true uses the request URL, or pass a custom URL).
sx-vars Object of template variables interpolated safely via encodeURIComponent into ${key} tokens.
sx-params Object serialized cleanly as query parameters via URLSearchParams (skips null/undefined/empty values).
sx-body / sx-body-type Request body expression and optional serializer override (json or form).
sx-headers / sx-include Dynamic per-request headers object; sx-include merges extra inputs/forms into FormData.
sx-json-into / .shallow Parses JSON response into a state path. Use sx-json-into.shallow to store large datasets unproxied via markRaw.
sx-loading-into / sx-error-into State paths updated during in-flight requests and on error (includes HTTP status and parsed response body).
sx-disable-while-request / sx-text-while-request Disables controls and temporarily swaps button text while a request is running.
sx-confirm / sx-cancel-previous Prompts window.confirm before sending; sx-cancel-previous aborts earlier in-flight requests on the same binding.
sx-optimistic / sx-revert-on-error Applies immediate optimistic state mutation and reverts if the request fails.
sx-poll / sx-poll-while / sx-poll-background Visibility-aware polling interval (pauses when tab is hidden unless sx-poll-background is set).

Navigation, Animation & Integrations

Attribute Description
sx-page / sx-page-ignore / sx-page-transition Enables SPA navigation via DOM morphing with scroll restoration, abortable fetches, per-link opt-out, and optional View Transitions.
sx-boost / sx-boost-on Prefetches internal links on hover/focus (set sx-boost="false" on a link to opt out).
sx-animate Auto-animates list/container children using @formkit/auto-animate.
sx-gridstack / option:* / on-* Declarative GridStack dashboard initialization, options, and event-to-state binding (preserved across partial swaps).
sx-sortable (opt-in) Accessible source-array reordering for keyed sx-for lists via SpruceX.createSortableIntegration().
03 · Performance

Fine-Grained Reactivity & Large Datasets

SpruceX tracks reactive dependencies per binding, loop, computed getter, and custom directive. Unrelated state updates never re-evaluate unaffected widgets or wipe sx-html subtrees.

Native Built-ins & Raw Datasets

Only plain objects and arrays are deep-proxied. Date, Map, Set, typed arrays, DOM nodes, and class instances keep their native internal slots. Wrap huge datasets with SpruceX.markRaw(rows) or fetch them with sx-json-into.shallow="rows".

Auto-Memoized Getters & Path Watchers

Own read-only getters on sx-data compute once per dependency change across all consumers. Watchers support dotted paths like watch: { 'filters.region'(next, prev) {} } without colliding with top-level keys.

Reactivity Primitives JS 
const rows = SpruceX.markRaw(largeDataset);   // skip deep proxying
const raw  = SpruceX.toRaw(component.state);  // unwrap before passing to Workers/Charts
const box  = SpruceX.shallow({ data: rows }); // shallow top-level reactivity
const sum  = SpruceX.computed(() => store.items.reduce((a, b) => a + b.v, 0));
const stop = SpruceX.effect(() => console.log(sum.value));
stop();
04 · Extensibility

Directives & Plugins

Element-Scoped Directives (SpruceX.directive)

Recommended for Charts & Widgets

Register reusable sx-* directives with built-in fine-grained effect() and automatic per-element cleanup(). Untouched directive instances stay alive across partial HTML swaps and only tear down when their own element is removed.

chart-directive.js JS 
SpruceX.directive("chart", (el, { evaluate, effect, cleanup, modifiers }) => {
  const chart = createChart(el, SpruceX.toRaw(evaluate()), {
    animate: modifiers.includes("animated"),
  });

  effect(() => {
    chart.update(SpruceX.toRaw(evaluate()));
  });

  cleanup(() => chart.destroy());
});

Component-Level Integrations (SpruceX.integration)

For container-wide plugins like sortable or gridstack, register lifecycle hooks (setup, scan, update, unmount, teardown). Set preserveOnSwap: true to keep untouched widgets mounted during partial swaps.

integration-plugin.js JS 
SpruceX.integration("uppercase", {
  preserveOnSwap: true,
  setup(component) { component._upper = new Map(); },
  scan(component, el) {
    const expr = el.getAttribute("sx-uppercase");
    if (expr) component._upper.set(el, expr);
  },
  update(component) {
    component._upper.forEach((expr, el) => {
      el.textContent = String(component.evaluateExpressionOrLiteral(expr) ?? "").toUpperCase();
    });
  },
  unmount(component, el) { component._upper.delete(el); },
  teardown(component) { component._upper.clear(); },
});
05 · Any Environment

Global Config, Shadow DOM & Strict CSP

Shadow DOM & Embedded Islands

Pass any Element or ShadowRoot to SpruceX.init(root), or mount single widgets imperatively with SpruceX.mount(el) and SpruceX.unmount(el). Auto-cleanup observes each root independently.

Tree-Shakeable Subpaths & CSP Mode

Import sprucex/core (no auto-init, no bundled integrations) alongside optional sprucex/sortable or sprucex/gridstack. Enable csp: true for environments disallowing unsafe-eval.

SpruceX.config(...) JS 
SpruceX.config({
  baseUrl: "https://api.example.com",
  credentials: "include",
  csrfCookieName: "XSRF-TOKEN",
  csrfHeaderName: "X-XSRF-TOKEN",
  headers: () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}` }),
  beforeRequest(ctx) {
    if (!ctx.url) return false; // cancel request
  },
  afterResponse({ response }) {
    if (response.status === 401) redirectToLogin();
  },
  csp: false,             // true enables built-in CSP-safe evaluator
  viewTransitions: true,  // wrap sx-page swaps in document.startViewTransition
});
06 · Navigation

SPA Navigation & DOM Morphing

Zero-Reload Morphing

Add sx-page to your main container to intercept internal links, cancel superseded fetches, restore scroll on Back/Forward, and morph content in place.

Turbo Boosting

Add sx-boost to prefetch links on hover/focus. Opt out individual links with sx-page-ignore or sx-boost="false".

Lifecycle Events

Listen to sprucex:page-before, sprucex:page-after, and sprucex:page-error on document for progress bars and analytics.

07 · Motion & Boot

Auto-Animate & Early Boot Hook

Zero-Config List Animations

Add sx-animate to any parent container to animate inserts, removals, and keyed reorders with @formkit/auto-animate.

sx-animate · sx-animate="300"
sx-animate='{"duration": 250, "easing": "ease-out"}'

Early Bootstrap Hook

Define window.SpruceXBoot before loading SpruceX to run head-safe theme setup or set autoInit: false.

window.SpruceXBoot = { initTheme() { ... }, autoInit: true }

SpruceX LLM.txt
Version: 1.2.0
Status: Active development.

Overview

SpruceX is a lightweight reactive HTML framework combining Alpine-style
declarative reactivity with HTMX-style hypermedia requests. It uses `sx-*`
attributes on plain HTML, supports fine-grained dependency tracking, custom
element-scoped directives, Shadow DOM embeds, and strict-CSP evaluation.

Install / Entry Points

- Browser bundle: `/dist/sprucex.js` or `/dist/sprucex.min.js`
- Full package: `import SpruceX from "sprucex"` (`lib/sprucex.mjs`, `lib/sprucex.cjs`, `lib/sprucex.d.ts`)
- Tree-shakeable core (no auto-init, no bundled integrations): `import SpruceX from "sprucex/core"`
- Optional subpath integrations: `sprucex/sortable`, `sprucex/gridstack`

Quick Start

<script src="/dist/sprucex.js"></script>

<div sx-data="{ count: 0 }">
  <button sx-on:click="count++">+1</button>
  <span sx-text="count"></span>
</div>

Core Directives

- `sx-data`: component root state (object/function/factory expression)
- `sx-text`: write `textContent` (no-op guarded)
- `sx-html`: write `innerHTML` (no-op guarded; does not wipe unchanged subtrees)
- `sx-show`: toggle visibility while preserving inline `display`
- `sx-if`: conditional mount/unmount on `<template>` (tears down nested state & directives)
- `sx-for`: keyed/unkeyed loop on `<template>` (`sx-key` recommended for reorders)
- `sx-bind:<attr>`: bind attributes (preserves `aria-*="false"`, syncs live `value`/`checked`/`indeterminate`)
- `sx-class`: conditional classes while preserving original classes
- `sx-style`: dynamic inline styles (object with camelCase / `--css-vars`, or string)
- `sx-cloak`: stripped automatically after initial render
- `sx-init`: one-time initialization statement on an element
- `sx-effect`: fine-grained reactive side effect on an element
- `sx-toggle`: toggle a boolean state key on click
- `sx-model`: two-way binding for inputs, textareas, single & `<select multiple>`
  Modifiers: `.trim`, `.number` (preserves empty string), `.boolean`, `.lazy`, `.debounce.<ms>`, `.debounce-ms="N"`
- `sx-ref`: register element on `$refs`
- `sx-memo`: cache `sx-text` / `sx-html` based on dependency keys
- `sx-local`: persist component state to `localStorage` (microtask-batched)
- `sx-lazy`: defer component init until element enters viewport (works on swapped/loop roots too)
- `sx-error-fallback`: fallback expression if a binding throws
- `script[sx-init-data]`: embedded JSON for identifier-style `sx-data` roots

Expressions & Magic Helpers

- `$event`: current DOM event in handlers
- `$el`: current DOM element
- `$refs`: object of `sx-ref` elements
- `$store(name)`: access global stores
- `$emit(name, detail)`: emit component-scoped custom event (triggers local `sx-trigger`)
- `$dispatch(name, detail)`: dispatch bubbling DOM `CustomEvent` (child-to-parent & cross-component)
- `$nextTick(fn?)`: wait until next batched render flush
- `$parent`: parent `sx-data` component state (if nested)
- `$index`: default loop index inside `sx-for`

Reactivity & Large-Dataset Helpers

- Plain objects and arrays are deeply reactive; built-ins (`Date`, `Map`, `Set`,
  `TypedArray`, DOM nodes, and custom class instances) stay unproxied.
- Own read-only getters on `sx-data` are automatically memoized via fine-grained tracking.
- `SpruceX.markRaw(obj)`: exclude large datasets/instances from deep proxying
- `SpruceX.toRaw(proxy)`: unwrap reactive proxy back to raw target
- `SpruceX.shallow(obj)`: shallow reactivity (only top-level property replacements trigger updates)
- `SpruceX.computed(fn)` / `SpruceX.effect(fn)` / `SpruceX.stop(runner)`: standalone reactive primitives
- Watchers in `sx-data`: `watch: { count(next, prev) {}, 'user.name'(next, prev) {} }` (path-aware)
- Lifecycle hooks in `sx-data`: `init()`, `mounted()`, `destroyed()`
- Global stores: `SpruceX.store(name, value, { persist, syncTabs })`, `SpruceX.removeStore(name)`
- Named factories: `SpruceX.data(name, factory)`

Event Handling

- `sx-on:<event>` attaches handlers (lazy root delegation)
- Modifiers: `.prevent`, `.stop`, `.self`, `.once`, `.outside`, `.window`, `.document`,
  `.passive`, `.capture`, `.debounce.<ms>`, `.throttle.<ms>`
- Keyboard modifiers: `.ctrl`, `.alt`, `.shift`, `.meta`, `.cmd` combinable with key names
  and aliases (`.enter`, `.esc`, `.space`, `.up`, `.down`, `.left`, `.right`, `.del`, etc.)

Network Directives

- Methods: `sx-get`, `sx-post`, `sx-put`, `sx-patch`, `sx-delete`
- Triggers: `sx-trigger` (supports `load`, `input.debounce.300`, and cross-component
  `event from:window|document|#selector`), `sx-trigger-debounce`
- Targeting & swaps: `sx-target`, `sx-swap` (`innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `before`, `after`,
  `prepend`, `append`, `morph`, `delete`, `none`), `sx-select`, `sx-push-url`, `sx-replace-url`
- URL/body/headers: `sx-vars` (URL-encoded `${key}`), `sx-params` (`URLSearchParams`),
  `sx-body`, `sx-body-type` (`json`/`form`), `sx-headers`, `sx-include`
- State targets: `sx-json-into`, `sx-json-into.shallow` (marks payload raw),
  `sx-loading-into`, `sx-error-into` (includes HTTP `status` and parsed `body`)
- UX & flow: `sx-disable-while-request`, `sx-text-while-request`, `sx-confirm`,
  `sx-optimistic`, `sx-revert-on-error`, `sx-cancel-previous`,
  `sx-poll` (visibility-aware; pauses when `document.hidden`), `sx-poll-while`, `sx-poll-background`

Global Configuration

SpruceX.config({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
  csrfCookieName: 'csrftoken',
  csrfHeaderName: 'X-CSRFToken',
  credentials: 'same-origin',
  headers: () => ({ Authorization: 'Bearer ...' }),
  beforeRequest(ctx) { /* mutate ctx.url/headers or return false to cancel */ },
  afterResponse(ctx) { /* inspect ctx.response */ },
  csp: false,
  debug: false,
  viewTransitions: false,
});

Navigation, Shadow DOM & Portability

- `sx-page`, `sx-page-ignore`, `sx-page-transition`, `sx-boost`, `sx-boost-on`, `sx-key`, `sx-preserve`
- `SpruceX.init(root?)`: initialize document, Element, or ShadowRoot with scoped auto-cleanup
- `SpruceX.mount(el, options?)` / `SpruceX.unmount(el)`
- `SpruceX.inspect(root?)`, `SpruceX.nextTick(fn?)`
- `SpruceX.navigate(url)`, `SpruceX.prefetch(url)`, `SpruceX.clearCache()`, `SpruceX.morph(target, source)`
- `window.SpruceXBoot = { initTheme() {}, autoInit: true }`

Element-Scoped Directives (Recommended for Charts & Widgets)

SpruceX.directive("chart", (el, { evaluate, effect, cleanup, modifiers }) => {
  const chart = createChart(el, SpruceX.toRaw(evaluate()), { modifiers });
  effect(() => chart.update(SpruceX.toRaw(evaluate())));
  cleanup(() => chart.destroy());
});

Component Integrations

SpruceX.integration(name, {
  preserveOnSwap: true, // keep untouched elements alive across partial HTML swaps
  setup(component) {},
  scan(component, el) {},
  update(component) {},
  unmount(component, el) {},
  teardown(component) {},
});
